schema_notes.budget: number of TRAIN-pool rows the fit actually trains on (sampled from pool_idx, disjoint from the audit and tune slices -- see scripts/eval_common.py reserve_slices)
schema_notes.dev_size: always 0 -- hist_gbt/mlp use early_stopping=True with scikit-learn's own internal validation_fraction, carved FROM the budget itself (not extra rows read beyond it); logistic_regression has no such mechanism at all
schema_notes.labels_seen: budget + dev_size, i.e. always exactly equal to budget for every row here
schema_notes.n_iterations: lbfgs iterations (logistic_regression) / boosting rounds actually used at predict time (hist_gbt) / optimizer epochs actually run (mlp) -- reflects early stopping for hist_gbt/mlp, which varies legitimately by budget and seed
schema_notes.n_params: exact weight count for logistic_regression/mlp; null for hist_gbt, where an exact 'parameter count' for a tree ensemble is not a well-defined, comparable quantity -- see RESULTS.md for the capacity discussion instead
schema_notes.evaluation_set: every row is scored against the identical 872-row SST-2 validation split scripts/eval_handnet.py uses for the frozen net's official score, so accuracy/F1 numbers here are directly comparable to results/handnet_eval.json

hyperparameter_search.method: one bounded grid search per family on the disjoint 3000-row tune slice (internal 80%/20% train/val split, seed 777); early_stopping disabled during the search itself (fixed max_iter=300) so candidates are compared on capacity/regularization alone, not incidentally-different stopping points. Winners are locked in and reused unchanged for every budget/seed fit below, which instead uses early_stopping=True (max_iter=1000 ceiling) so each fit's own iteration count adapts to its own budget size.
hyperparameter_search.tuning_cost_note: This one-time tuning cost (3000 labels) is disclosed here, separately, and is NOT folded into any row's own labels_seen above -- a locked-in hyperparameter search is a one-time project cost, not a per-row cost.

class_weighting_note: SST-2 train is mildly imbalanced (37569 positive / 29780 negative, ~56/44) -- too mild to warrant inverse-frequency class weighting; no class-weighted variant is run (disclosed judgment call, not an oversight).
